title: uqe: TestResolveCloudTkBinarySuppressesUpdateCheck must not require tk on PATH
description: Found by CI on PR #80 (ticfac gate run of epic cia): cmd/tk/cmd/cloud_tk_test.go:252 TestResolveCloudTkBinarySuppressesUpdateCheck fails on CI with "resolveCloudTkBinary: cannot find a tk to read the tracker with: exec: tk: executable file not found in $PATH". The test written for tick uqe (tk self-invocation skips the update check) assumes an installed tk. Make it self-sufficient: build tk into a temp dir (go build ./cmd/tk) or point resolveCloudTkBinary at a fake executable on a temp PATH, so the test proves the suppression without an installed binary. CI job: go / "Contract bundle and parity fixtures", run 34218832742.
notes: 2026-09-08 13:42 - ticfac run gate-cia-3: attempt 1 merged into epic/cia as 2649fe48e3f9; the integrated gate (go, pi-runner) passed.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./cmd/tk/cmd/ -run TestResolveCloudTkBinarySuppressesUpdateCheck passes with an empty PATH (no installed tk); go test -short -count=1 ./... green
